definitions.explanation: A cooperative arrangement or business partnership between organizations for mutual benefit.

examples.japanese: A⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧とB⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧{提携|ていけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}んだ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
examples.english: Company A and Company B formed a business alliance.

examples.japanese: {提携|ていけい}カードで⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{受|う}けられる→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: You can get a discount with the partner card.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧との{提携|ていけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: To advance partnerships with overseas companies.

notes:
{提携|ていけい} refers to a formal cooperative arrangement between organizations for mutual benefit. Common in business and institutional contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧{提携|ていけい}: business alliance
- ⟦{資本|しほん}→資本：03197_shihon⟧{提携|ていけい}: capital alliance (equity partnership)
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧{提携|ていけい}: technical partnership
- {提携|ていけい}カード: affiliated card (e.g., co-branded credit card)
- {提携|ていけい}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: partner company/organization

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {提携|ていけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧: to form a partnership
- {提携|ていけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}→解消：14143_kaishou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dissolve a partnership
- {提携|ていけい}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: partnership relationship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連携|れんけい}→連携：05094_renkei⟧: cooperation, coordination (ongoing collaboration)
- ⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧: cooperation (general)
- {合弁|ごうべん}: joint venture (shared investment)
